blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Sometimes people do not agree. This is normal. A small conflict can happen in any team. Maybe it is about a project, a deadline, or a simple message.

The important thing is to stay calm. Listen to the other person first. Many small problems are only a misunderstanding, not a real fight.

HR can help when the conflict is bigger. But often, a simple conversation is enough. Calm words solve many problems.

items.q: According to the text, is a small conflict normal in a team?
items.why: "A small conflict can happen in any team." — o texto diz que é normal.

items.q: What should you do first?
items.why: "stay calm. Listen to the other person first."

items.q: When can HR help?
items.why: "HR can help when the conflict is bigger."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: A calm talk can solve a small problem
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que muitas vezes uma conversa simples basta — nem todo conflito precisa do RH.

items.q: The text suggests that a misunderstanding is…
options: the same as a big fight
items.why: Inferência: "only a misunderstanding, not a real fight" — é algo menor e mais fácil de resolver.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James ajudando dois colegas. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, let's all sit down for a minute. I know there is a small problem about the report. That is okay. This happens in every team.

Anna, you say the numbers were wrong. Marco, you say you sent the new file on Friday. So maybe this is only a misunderstanding, not a real conflict. Let's stay calm and listen to each other.

Marco, can you show us the email with the file? Good. And Anna, can you tell us which numbers were not clear? Thank you. I think you both wanted the same thing — a good report on time.

Why don't we do this? Marco sends the file again now, and Anna checks it today. A short apology from both sides, and we move on. Let's agree on a simple way forward and finish this together.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the small problem about?
items.why: "there is a small problem about the report."

items.q: What does James ask Marco to show?
items.why: "Marco, can you show us the email with the file?"

items.q: What is James's plan?
options: Marco sends the file again and Anna checks it today
items.why: "Marco sends the file again now, and Anna checks it today."

items.q: James suggests that Anna and Marco really wanted…
options: the same thing — a good report on time
items.why: Inferência: "I think you both wanted the same thing — a good report on time."

items.q: How would you describe James's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele mantém a calma, ouve os dois e propõe uma solução simples.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "They had a small conflict about the deadline." A conflict is…
items.why: Conflict = conflito, um desacordo entre pessoas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "It was not a real fight. It was only a ___."
items.why: Misunderstanding = mal-entendido, algo menor que um conflito de verdade.

items.q: "Please listen to your colleague first." To listen means to…
items.why: To listen = ouvir com atenção.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Let's find a good ___ for this problem."
items.why: Solution = solução, a resposta para o problema.

items.q: "A short apology can fix many small problems." An apology is…
items.why: Apology = desculpa, quando você diz "sorry".

blocks.instruction: Expressões úteis para acalmar um conflito no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's talk about it and find a solution." Let's means…
options: let us (a suggestion to do together)
items.why: Let's = let us: uma sugestão para fazermos algo juntos.

items.q: "Why don't we sit down and talk calmly?" This is a way to…
items.why: Why don't we…? = uma forma educada de sugerir algo.

items.q: "Let's calm down before we talk." To calm down means to…
items.why: Calm down = acalmar-se, ficar tranquilo.

items.q: "Can we sort out this problem today?" To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, organizar o problema.

items.q: "Let's move on and finish the report." To move on means to…
items.why: Move on = seguir em frente depois de resolver algo.
